method_audit.assumptions: At least two populated levels per main effect and replicated crossed cells for interaction.
method_audit.limitations: The Cotter sensory dataset fixes preparation and roast; the Yeager dataset varies context but reports chemistry, not sensory outcomes.
method_audit.output: Sufficiency and identifiability gate; no coefficient estimation.
method_audit.research_question: Do preparation, roast, or their interaction add information about sensory outcomes?

results.milk_mode: EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT: no imported milk-coffee sensory outcomes.
results.preparation_roast_interaction: NOT_ESTIMABLE: sensory rows occupy one preparation-by-roast cell.
results.preparation_signal: NOT_ESTIMABLE: sensory rows contain one preparation family.
results.roast_signal: NOT_ESTIMABLE: sensory rows contain one roast category.
